---
title: "Optional input"
---

Here we provide an overview of all optional/ non essential settings that the user can provide to FIAT. These are listed in the table (@tbl-toml) below.

| Field                                         | Type        | Default       |
|:----------------------------------------------|-------------|---------------|
| [loglevel](#model)                            | string      | INFO          |
| [risk](#model)                                | boolean     | false         |
| **[projection]**                              |             |               |
| [crs](#projection)                            | string      | -             |
| [force](#projection)                          | boolean     | false         |
| **[[output]]** (geom) / **[output]** (grid)   |             |               |
| [file](#output)                               | string      | see below     |
| **[hazard]**                                  |             |               |
| [resalg](#hazard)                             | string      | nearest       |
| **[hazard.settings]**                         |             |               |
| [crs](#hazard)                                | string      | -             |
| **[[hazard.variables]]**                      |             |               |
| [name, type, rp, value](#hazard.variables)    |             | -             |
| **[[exposure]]** (geom)                       |             |               |
| [area_method](#exposure-geom)                 | string      | centroid      |
| [impact_type](#exposure-geom)                 | list        | ['damage']    |
| [zonal_method](#exposure-geom)                | string      | mean          |
| **[exposure.settings]** (geom)                |             |               |
| [crs](#exposure-geom)                         | string      | -             |
| **[exposure]** (grid)                         |             |               |
| [resalg](#exposure-grid)                      | string      | nearest       |
| **[exposure.settings]** (grid)                |             |               |
| [crs](#exposure-grid)                         | string      | -             |
| **[[exposure.variables]]** (grid)             |             |               |
| [name, type, vulnerability, fn_curve, values, value](#exposure.variables) | | - |
| **[[vulnerability.variables]]**               |             |               |
| [name, method, types](#vulnerability.variables) |           | -             |
: Settings.toml input (optional fields) {#tbl-toml .hover}

#### Model

- `loglevel`: Set the loglevel of the fiat logger from the settings file. Choose from 'DEBUG', 'INFO', 'WARNING', 'ERROR' or 'DEAD'.

- `risk`: In case of a risk calculation this must be set to "true", for a single events this must be set to "false".

#### [projection]

- `crs`: Model-wide projection for the model and the output. If not defined, the projection of the hazard data is used.

- `force`: Whether to force the model-wide projection on all the spatial input files.

#### [output]

- `file`: The name of the output file. For the geometry model there is an `[[output]]` entry per `[[exposure]]` entry; by default the name of the exposure file. For the grid model it is a single `[output]` section; by default the name of the exposure file with a `.tif` suffix.

#### [hazard]

- `resalg`: Method used during resampling/ reprojecting. Default is 'nearest', i.e. nearest neighbour.

- `settings.crs`: Projection of the hazard data if it cannot be inferred from the dataset itself.

#### Variables
The variables of the input data (vulnerability datasets, hazard bands and gridded exposure layers) that are used are specified with a `variables` entry per variable; at least one entry is required for each of them. These entries are the **only** source of the attributes of the variables: attributes in the files (e.g. `type`, `rp`, `method`) are not read, and variables of a file without an entry are ignored. Every `name` must exist in its file, unless the entry defines a uniform layer with `value` (hazard and grid exposure only). A `value` entry must name a variable that is not in the file.

##### [[hazard.variables]]

- `name`: Name of the band (variable).
- `type`: The hazard type, e.g. 'water_depth' or 'duration' (required).
- `rp`: The return period of the band (required for every band when `risk` is true).
- `value`: Constant value of a uniform layer that is not in the file.

See [hazard data](../data/hazard.qmd#settings).

##### [[exposure.variables]]

Only for the grid model.

- `name`: Name of the layer (variable).
- `type`: The exposure type (required): 'default' or 'categorized' for a layer, 'values' for a category-value variable.
- `vulnerability`: The vulnerability dataset(s) linked to this variable, a name or a list of names.
- `fn_curve`: The curve id looked up in the linked vulnerability dataset(s) (required for type 'default').
- `values`: The category-value variables of a categorized layer.
- `value`: Constant value of a uniform layer that is not in the file.

See [grid exposure data](../data/exposure/grid.qmd#settings).

##### [[vulnerability.variables]]

- `name`: Name of the vulnerability dataset (variable).
- `method`: The calculation method of the dataset, e.g. 'flood.depth' (required).
- `types`: The hazard type per index dimension of the dataset, e.g. `{ depth_default = "water_depth" }` (required).

See [vulnerability data](../data/vulnerability.qmd#settings).

#### [exposure] (geom) {#exposure-geom}

- `area_method`: The method of extracting hazard values based on the exposure geometry. Choose 'centroid' or 'area'.

- `impact_type`: Types of impact. This could be monetary damages ('damage'), affected people ('affected') etc.

- `zonal_method`: The method of aggregating the hazard values of an asset when `area_method` is set to 'area'. Choose 'mean', 'max' or 'min'.

- `settings.crs`: Projection of the exposure geometry data if it cannot be inferred from the dataset itself.

#### [exposure] (grid) {#exposure-grid}

- `resalg`: Method used during resampling/ reprojecting. Default is 'nearest', i.e. nearest neighbour.

- `settings.crs`: Projection of the gridded exposure data if it cannot be inferred from the dataset itself.
